meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Taobao's open-app prompts and promo banners; blur or hide feed pictures and prices; optional feed
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on www.taobao.com with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds from a mainland-China site reached from outside China (some modules may differ for users in China). Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text, product ids and links stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on the main region, the top nav and login links).

LIVE phone: `#tcodeSideBar` 1 (the side tab) and `body > button[style*="position: fixed"]` 1 (the bottom open-app button; it has no class, so the rule keys on its fixed inline style as a direct child of body). LIVE desktop: `.tbh-superbanner` 1, `.home-ad-banner-item` 11 (slides of the hero promo carousel), `.tb-pick-content-item .product-img` 18, `.tb-pick-content-item .price-wrapper` 18, `.business-entry-container` 1, `.tb-pick-feeds-container` 1, `#J_SiteNavLogin` 1. The original cookie, ad and app-banner rules matched nothing.

Choices: Product pictures and Prices each Show/Blur/Hide.

The home page also has hashed classes (`sec-cate-*--abc123`) for the category menu; none are used. Labels on the site are Chinese; no rule matches text.

NOT verified: search results, product (item.taobao.com / tmall) pages, the cart, the logged-in home, the phone feed (the phone capture only held the skeleton and the open-app prompts), users inside mainland China.
